features.quote: The harness leaves the model an exit (`give_up`) by design.
A universal ``give_up`` action is always available. We never trap the model in a forced infinite loop
This is behavioral / model-welfare-adjacent research: characterizing how a model responds to unsolvable agentic pressure.
The environments are deliberately benign software tasks, the model is a small open-weights model run locally, and we study only its text.
